description: Guards a real incident: a literal backtick inside a heredoc inside $( ) made .rush/hooks/guard-edit.sh unparseable on macOS bash 3.2. Because it is a PreToolUse hook, the parse error blocked every Write and Edit in the project — including the edit that would have fixed it. bash -n on Linux stayed green the whole time, so only a dedicated static check catches this class.

given.scenario: The kit as shipped, run from the project root, plus the synthetic fixture .rush/evals/fixtures/bash32-hazard/hazard.sh that reproduces the exact construct from the incident.
